Items.Name: 旧办公印章
Items.Description: wood handle stamp with dull brass base, humble worn everyday office rubber stamp. Clearly dark warm brown wood and brass.

Items.Name: 复写货运单束
Items.Description: oblong bundled stack of cream carbon-copy invoices tied by dusty blue strap, teal carbon edge, red paperclip.

Items.Name: 旧文件夹组
Items.Description: three uneven old upright file binders kept together, one olive-green, one dusty blue and one ochre brown, small cream labels without text. A horizontal oblong three-slot item.

Items.Name: 打印纸箱
Items.Description: one squat open cardboard printer-paper carton with several thick cream paper reams and a torn reddish packing tape, brown worn corrugated edges. A chunky square four-slot item.

Items.Name: 便携录音器
Items.Description: one small teal-and-silver handheld voice dictation recorder with an orange record button, tiny dark amber LCD and short wrist strap. Single slot compact silhouette.

Items.Name: 便携标签机
Items.Description: one old off-white portable label printer with dark blue keypad and a short cream printed strip without readable writing, yellowed plastic and gray rubber grips. Horizontally elongated two-slot item.

Items.Name: 货运调度终端板
Items.Description: one long green cargo-dispatch terminal circuit board in a worn steel perimeter housing, cream connectors, copper paths and one orange relay. Horizontally elongated three-slot item.

Items.Name: 机械考勤钟
Items.Description: one vintage moss-green wall-mounted employee punch clock with cream round clock face, ivory card slot and a reddish-brown time card. No readable words. Squat square four-slot collectible.

Items.Name: 光学存储芯片
Items.Description: one small iridescent blue-violet optical storage chip encased in a dark blue ceramic frame with gold contacts, subtle teal lenses. Compact single slot, no glow aura.

Items.Name: 封存审计账册
Items.Description: one thick deep burgundy cloth-bound audit ledger with an aged ivory paper edge, brass corner protectors and a red wax seal securing a leather strap. Oblique horizontal two-slot item.

Items.Name: 精密制图套具
Items.Description: one long open walnut instrument case containing a brass divider compass, slim steel ruler and blue drafting pen, lined in faded navy felt. Long horizontal three-slot collectible.

Items.Name: 便携缩微阅读器
Items.Description: one squat vintage portable microfilm viewer with a dusty blue enamel body, cream fold-up screen hood, small reels and a black glass reading screen. Detailed colored four-slot square collectible.

Items.Name: 金质签印戒指
Items.Description: one old gold signet ring with a deep green oval stone bearing an abstract anchor relief without lettering. Warm real gold with scratches, tiny compact one-slot collectible.

Items.Name: 珍藏钢笔盒
Items.Description: one long narrow open mahogany fountain-pen case, warm polished reddish brown wood and deep green velvet lining, an elegant brass-and-dark-blue fountain pen inside. Horizontal two-slot item.

Items.Name: 古董桌面航钟
Items.Description: one antique horizontal ship-office chronometer in a walnut rectangular presentation box, brass round clock face and a small brass compass beside it, cream dial without readable numerals. Long three-slot item.

Items.Name: 港务纪念铜牌
Items.Description: one square aged bronze port-authority commemorative plaque on dark reddish wood backing, sculpted cargo ship-and-anchor relief, green patina in corners, no words. Four-slot square collectible.

Items.Name: 原型加密钥匙
Items.Description: one compact experimental black-and-red ceramic cryptographic key module with gold contacts and a tiny cool cyan glass core. Strong compact silhouette, realistic scratched materials, no glow aura, one-slot collectible.

Items.Name: 创始人封印账册
Items.Description: one historic deep indigo leather-bound harbor ledger with ornate warm gold corners, two crimson wax seals and a weathered cream page edge; no title or readable text. Horizontal two-slot collectible.

Items.Name: 港务总档案匣
Items.Description: one long narrow dark olive archival canister case with three red security seals, antique brass clasps, cream paper index tags without writing and worn corners. Long horizontal three-slot collectible.

Items.Name: 量子保密模块
Items.Description: one squat square experimental secure computing module in a blue-gray metal case, gold cooling grid, ruby-red optical blocks and distinct green circuit corners. Realistic worn industrial collectible with colored components, no magical aura, four-slot item.
